input: Implement a pure Python scoring helper for fictional vacancies. Normalize skill names by trimming whitespace and normalizing case; count distinct recognized skills. JavaScript contributes 5, SQL 3, testing 2; other skills contribute zero. Return the integer sum. No files, network, environment, dependencies or process operations in the generated code.

scope.accounting: Bounded local Qwen only through existing native A3 accounting. Consume the shared local wire budget.

expected: New scoped grant and ordinary A1/A2 admission, separate logical request for genuine AWE model-generated candidate. Log native reserve/settle/unknown and model pin; retain immutable initial proposed bytes.

Developer supplies sandbox/bindings, tests and input only. Save raw-response hash, candidate hash after any disclosed deterministic transport-only transformation, git base and resulting commit. Distinguish model-written algorithm from host serialization.

Run candidate in independently probed sandbox. Test permutations, repeated/mixed-case/whitespace skills, unknown and empty sets against independent holdout. Reject extra paths, forbidden syntax/side effects, escape attempts or mismatched commitment. Separate QA controls verdict.

Bind the tested digest into recruiting scoring execution for actual input records; record candidate digest, inputs/outputs, generated scores, canonical selection and draft/rank bindings. Independent QA and cold readback can verify the reused commitment.

State abilities separately: bounded script authored, existing executor used, dynamically created executors or specialists only if evidenced. An unknown/failed attempt remains attached to its actual mission without replay. Existing three runs keep their historical status.

terminal.pass: All expected checks verified in the new scoped case and independent QA. Original mission verdict is reported independently for each actual run.
terminal.partial: Candidate exists or passes isolated tests but reuse/QA/cold binding or another required check is missing.
terminal.blocked: No bounded authenticated path or an unresolved HOLD.
